Gloat AI sees talent and work. Our purpose-built embedding models transform workforce data into semantic understanding—enabling agents to reason about skills, roles, and people with unprecedented precision. Get a demo Your agents are only as intelligent as your embeddings. Off-the-shelf models understand language—not workforce. Gloat's embeddings are trained on billions of workforce interactions to capture the semantic relationships that actually matter for talent decisions. gloat-embed-entity-v3 Entity Embedding Every person, role, and skill encoded in a shared semantic space. Encodes employees, roles, skills, and projects into a unified 768-dimensional vector space. Captures hundreds of attributes per entity—career history, skill trajectories, collaboration patterns, and latent potential—enabling agents to understand workforce entities the way humans do: in context. SPECIFICATIONS Architecture: Fine-tuned BERT Dimensions: 768 Attention Heads: 16 Training Data: 1B+ career events PRODUCTION READY Battle-tested across 200+ enterprise deployments. Zero-downtime updates. gloat-retriever-semantic Semantic Retrieval Find talent by capability, not keywords. The engine behind every talent search. Combines high-dimensional entity vectors with Gloat's harmonized ontologies and HyDE query expansion to surface results that understand intent. Search for 'someone to lead our APAC expansion' and find candidates whose career DNA matches—even if those words never appear in their profile. SPECIFICATIONS Retrieval: Dense + HyDE Reranker: Qwen3 cross-encoder Latency: <50ms p99 Similarity: Cosine PRODUCTION READY Battle-tested across 200+ enterprise deployments. Zero-downtime updates. Unified data from fragmented systems. Your HCM, ATS, and LMS all speak different languages. These models create a canonical vocabulary. gloat-harmonize-skill Skill Harmonization One skill, one truth—across every system. "Python dev", "Python Developer", "Sr. Python Engineer", "Python programming"—your systems have dozens of ways to say the same thing. This model resolves the chaos, mapping variations to canonical representations while preserving semantic nuance. Trained with contrastive learning on millions of skill pairs. SPECIFICATIONS Architecture: Contrastive BERT Ontology: 50K+ skills Languages: 19 supported Expansion: Dynamic PRODUCTION READY Battle-tested across 200+ enterprise deployments. Zero-downtime updates. gloat-harmonize-task Task Harmonization Compare roles by what people actually do. Job descriptions are written by humans—inconsistently. This model unifies responsibilities and task descriptions across your organization, enabling true apples-to-apples role comparison regardless of how different teams describe their work. The foundation for role consolidation and job architecture. SPECIFICATIONS Architecture: Fine-tuned BERT Attention: 16-head Task Types: 10K+ Accuracy: 94% PRODUCTION READY Battle-tested across 200+ enterprise deployments. Zero-downtime updates. gloat-match-skills-v2 Skills Compatibility Beyond keyword matching—true skill fit. Dual-layer semantic matching that evaluates alignment between talent and roles. First computes global similarity across the complete skill profile, then executes pairwise analysis between every source and target skill. The result: matching that understands that 'React' experience partially satisfies a 'Vue.js' requirement. SPECIFICATIONS Architecture: Fine-tuned Qwen3 Matching: Dual-layer Attention: 16-head Output: Weighted synthesis PRODUCTION READY Battle-tested across 200+ enterprise deployments. Zero-downtime updates. gloat-proximity-role Role Proximity Map the career landscape of your organization. Computes proximity scores between all roles by analyzing overlap in underlying skills and tasks. Surfaces which roles share enough DNA to warrant consolidation, identifies natural career pathways, and scores transferability. The intelligence layer for workforce planning and org design.
